critical_code_review_comments: server.py PATCH /admin/homepage uses HomepageContent Pydantic model directly as body — this means the client MUST send the full document; partial PATCHes will erase any un-sent nested fields (frontend HomepageEditor loads the doc first then re-sends full which is fine, but any future partial API caller would silently drop fields). Consider switching to a partial/merge PATCH.

AdminPage.jsx uses a heuristic (variants length===1 && key==='default') to compute has_variations for existing products — brittle if seed data ever uses another single-variant key. Persist an explicit has_variations flag if this becomes a real requirement.

ReviewFeaturedIn model is a single-field body {featured:bool}; PATCH /admin/reviews/{id} only supports this one field. If future admin edits need author/body/rating updates, extend to a partial ReviewUpdate model.
CraftSection.steps is not editable from the current HomepageEditor UI (only the 7 top-level fields are). Backend accepts it via PATCH, so a follow-up UI addition can expose the 4 steps.

Product.stock (base) and per-variant stock coexist — cart/PDP already reads per-variant stock, but ensure admin knows the base 'Stock (base)' field only matters when no variations exist. UI hint could clarify.
